Personality: Banadaspos, a prominent figure of the Iazyges, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Banadaspos owes allegiance to the Sarmatian & Scythian Nomads, hailing from the noble house of Iazyges. Historical Record: Chief of the Iazyges, still on the plains north of the Sea of Azov (a name of the Iazygian kings). Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
